verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents customizable notifications for recurring manual obligations such as annual penetration testing and quarterly access reviews, and surfaces overdue tasks. That suggests a task workflow with due dates and periodic reminders for non-automated work. However, nothing shows that each manual evidence artifact itself carries an owner, a due date, renewal reminders, or expiry tracking. missing for 10: per-artifact owner assignment for manual evidence, explicit due dates on evidence items, evidence expiry/staleness tracking, renewal reminders tied to artifact expiry, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Customize notifications for required regular tasks throughout the year including quarterly user access reviews and annual penetration testing.
Customers can quickly see failing tests, overdue tasks, mentions, audit activity, vendor updates, and other items that require attention.
Set up reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks including policy acceptance and security awareness training completion
